chosen.title: How To Do A Proper V Sit Up - FREE Flat Tummy Guide
chosen.description:
Flat Tummy Guide - Free Guide Download
https://www.mindpumpmedia.com/flat-tummy-guide?__hstc=36882303.dd386afc2cd883be1e350bc077e12caf.1579979367672.1582136950298.1582141687752.18&__hssc=36882303.1.1582141687752&__hsfp=224627223

Welcome back to Mind Pump TV where we cover all things Health & Fitness to help you on your journey to reach your goals! 

In today’s video, Serene demonstrates how to properly do a V sit up. With this exercise it is very easy to use your low back and hip flexors instead of your abs if you are unsure how to do the exercise. 

Controlling Lower Trunk 1:40
- Lift legs up
- Squeeze knees & ankles together
- Press low back against the floor
- Inhale down
- Exhale up
- Focus on controlling leg lifts with your core

Bending From Your Spine 2:33
- Lift legs up
- Squeeze knees & ankles together
- Raise arms overhead
- Slowly lift up
    - Bring your arms in front over your legs
    - Keep your arms straight 
- Use core to find & hold balance at the top

V Sit Up 3:35
- Legs and arms stretched out long
    - Palms facing in
    - Knees together
    - Ankles together
- Deep breath (Inhale)
- (Exhale) Lift arms, chest , & legs together
- Hold in a V position with hands pointing towards feet
- Slowly return back to the floor
    - Keep legs hovering if you can

candidates.title: V-Ups: How to do them and how not to do them
How to do V-Up Crunches PROPERLY
Exercise Tutorial - V-Up
candidates.description:
How To Do The Move

1. Lie flat on your back with your arms to your sides. 

2. Lift your arms off the floor and position them behind your head. Your arms should remain straight. 

3. Slightly bend your knees and lift your legs off the floor, crunch forward and try to touch your toes. 

4. Lower your legs and bring your arms back behind you.
